## 📊 Project Overview

The **Retail Sales Analytics Dashboard** is an interactive **Power BI business intelligence project** developed to analyze retail sales performance, outlet characteristics, product categories, customer ratings, and location-based performance.

The project transforms raw retail sales data into an interactive analytical solution using **Power Query, DAX, KPI cards, charts, tables, and dynamic slicers**.

The dashboard contains **two interactive pages**:

* 📈 **Sales Overview**
* 🏪 **Outlet & Item Analysis**

The dashboard is designed to help users quickly identify sales patterns, compare outlet performance, and understand product-level contribution.

---

# 🎯 Project Objectives

The main objectives of this project are to:

* Analyze overall retail sales performance
* Compare sales across different outlet types
* Analyze sales by outlet establishment year
* Identify high-performing item categories
* Analyze sales based on outlet size
* Understand outlet location performance
* Analyze item fat-content contribution
* Compare outlet ratings
* Identify differences between outlet formats
* Build an interactive Power BI dashboard
* Present retail data through a clean, business-friendly interface

---

## 💰 Sales Performance

The dashboard provides an overview of retail sales performance and allows users to analyze sales across different outlet characteristics.

### Analysis includes:

* Total Sales
* Average Sales
* Sales by Outlet Type
* Sales by Outlet Size
* Sales by Outlet Location
* Sales by Establishment Year
* Sales by Item Type
* Sales by Item Fat Content

---

## 🏪 Outlet Analysis

Outlet performance is analyzed using multiple dimensions:

* Outlet Type
* Outlet Size
* Outlet Location Type
* Outlet Establishment Year

This enables users to compare outlet formats and understand how location and outlet characteristics relate to sales performance.

---

## 🥫 Item Analysis

The dashboard analyzes sales across multiple product categories, including:

* Fruits and Vegetables
* Snack Foods
* Household
* Frozen Foods
* Dairy
* Canned
* Baking Goods
* Health and Hygiene
* Meat
* Soft Drinks
* Breads
* Hard Drinks
* Others
* Starchy Foods
* Breakfast
* Seafood

---

## ⭐ Rating Analysis

Average ratings are included as an additional performance metric alongside sales.

The dashboard enables comparison of:

**Sales Performance + Average Rating**

across different outlet types.

This provides a broader view of outlet performance rather than relying only on sales values.

---

# 🎛️ Interactive Filters

The dashboard contains interactive slicers that allow users to dynamically explore the dataset.

### Available Filters

* 🏪 Outlet Type
* 📍 Outlet Location Type
* 🥫 Item Type
* 📏 Outlet Size

### 🔄 Clear All Slicers

A **Clear All Slicers** option is included to quickly reset the dashboard filters and return to the default view.

# 📐 Dashboard Design

The dashboard was designed using a **Gopuff-inspired retail visual theme** focused on readability and business usability.

### 🎨 Design Elements

* Warm cream background
* Dark brown navigation panel
* Orange branding accents
* Green analytical visuals
* KPI cards
* Rounded visual containers
* Custom background image

The visual design combines retail branding with analytical elements to create a modern Power BI reporting experience.
